parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle of the bucket is a curved plastic rod attached to the upper sides of the bucket, allowing it to be carried easily.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a grip for lifting and carrying the bucket, distributing the weight evenly when filled with liquid or solid materials.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can rotate or pivot around its attachment points to the bucket body, allowing it to move up and down for carrying or resting positions.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container portion of the bucket, typically made of durable plastic with a cylindrical or conical shape.
parts.Functional_description: It holds liquids or solids, providing the main storage capacity of the bucket.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is a rigid, non-moving part that remains stationary while the handle moves for carrying.
